name: Mumbai
localTradeInfo: Mumbai is India's principal bullion trading hub. Daily retail prices in Zaveri Bazaar directly track port import costs and MCX benchmark rates with minimal regional markup.

name: Delhi
localTradeInfo: Kucha Mahajani in Chandni Chowk is North India's largest wholesale bullion exchange, accounting for heavy wholesale silver transactions and custom silverware craft.

name: Chennai
localTradeInfo: Sowcarpet acts as the primary trading node for silver anklets, kolusu, and temple utensils. South Indian markets typically trade at a slight logistics premium over Mumbai.

name: Bangalore
localTradeInfo: Raja Market on Avenue Road is Bangalore's historic bullion corridor, catering to large tech retail buyers and traditional puja silverware artisans.

name: Kolkata
localTradeInfo: Bowbazar and Burrabazar are legendary bullion quarters in Eastern India, known for intricate filigree silver craftsmanship and investment bars.

name: Hyderabad
localTradeInfo: Gulzar Houz near Charminar has traded pure silver ornaments and Bidri crafts for centuries, with daily bullion rates tightly linked to South Indian trade guilds.

name: Ahmedabad
localTradeInfo: Manek Chowk serves as Gujarat's premier bullion clearing ground. Gujarat is a leading consumer of industrial silver and silver casting units.

name: Pune
localTradeInfo: Raviwar Peth is the bustling nerve center for western Maharashtra bullion dealers, closely tracking Mumbai spot benchmarks.

name: Jaipur
localTradeInfo: Johari Bazaar is a globally celebrated center for 925 sterling silver gemstone jewelry, silverware, and traditional Rajasthani silver ornaments.

name: Surat
localTradeInfo: Surat pairs diamond trading prowess with rapid retail silver jewelry fabrication and high-purity silver bar consumption.

name: Lucknow
localTradeInfo: Chowk is the epicenter for silver foil (vark) manufacturing and delicate silver filigree work cherished across Awadh.

name: Kanpur
localTradeInfo: Naya Ganj and Birhana Road represent Central UP's primary bullion exchange, supplying silver bars to regional manufacturing clusters.

name: Nagpur
localTradeInfo: Itwari Sarafa is Central India's key bullion distribution pivot, serving eastern Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh.

name: Indore
localTradeInfo: Indore's Sarafa Bazaar is legendary for trading bullion by day and transforming into a lively street food market by night.

name: Coimbatore
localTradeInfo: Known as the Manchester of South India, Coimbatore has an expansive network of silver casting foundries and wedding silverware merchants.

name: Kochi
localTradeInfo: Kerala markets emphasize hallmark certified 999 fine silver bars and traditional temple lamps (nilavilakku) cast in pure silver.

name: Patna
localTradeInfo: Bakarganj is Bihar's largest organized bullion cluster, witnessing seasonal spikes in silver coins during Dhanteras and Chhath.

name: Bhopal
localTradeInfo: Sarafa Chowk in Old Bhopal supplies traditional tribal silver adornments and standard investment bars across the Malwa plateau.

name: Vadodara
localTradeInfo: Mandvi is the royal cultural city's historic silver bullion center, catering to institutional investors and temple trusts.

name: Chandigarh
localTradeInfo: Sector 22-D houses the Tricity's foremost hallmarked silver showroom row, serving retail buyers from Punjab, Haryana, and Himachal.

name: Visakhapatnam
localTradeInfo: Kurupam Market in the port city of Vizag is Coastal Andhra's major bullion trading zone, heavily favored for silver idols and giftware.

name: Vijayawada
localTradeInfo: One Town Sarafa is a high-volume commercial hub where agrarian surpluses are traditionally allocated into physical silver bars.

name: Madurai
localTradeInfo: South Avani Moola Street near the Meenakshi Amman Temple hosts master craftsmen producing silver kavasam (sacred armor) and devotional ware.

name: Varanasi
localTradeInfo: Thatheri Bazaar is the ancient guild lane of metal smiths, celebrated for silver puja thalis, incense burners, and intricate engraving.

name: Rajkot
localTradeInfo: Soni Bazaar in Rajkot is arguably India's biggest manufacturing capital for hollow silver jewelry, chains, and silver casting components.

name: Amritsar
localTradeInfo: Guru Bazaar, situated right beside the Golden Temple, has catered to North Indian bullion merchants and wedding silverware shoppers for over 400 years.

name: Agra
localTradeInfo: Namak Ki Mandi in Agra is renowned nationally for wholesale payal (anklet) and silver chain production supplied across northern and eastern states.

name: Nashik
localTradeInfo: Saraf Bazaar in Old Nashik serves as the primary pilgrimage bullion trading post along the Godavari, active in silver ritual items and bullions.

name: Ludhiana
localTradeInfo: Ludhiana's industrial entrepreneurs actively trade physical silver bullion and silver coins as a treasury hedge against currency fluctuation.

name: Bhubaneswar
localTradeInfo: Connected with neighboring Cuttack's GI-tagged 'Chandi Tarakasi' (silver filigree), Bhubaneswar represents Odisha's premier retail silver marketplace.
